verdict.rationale: monday.com's own marketing says its agents surface insights from user data inside the product: they "surface deep intelligence and actionable insights," "spot risks and progress gaps," automate performance reports, summarize calls and extract action items, and score open deals. This covers both insights and suggestions in-product, but every claim is a one-line homepage statement. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how insights are generated, which data sources are used and how suggestions appear in the UI, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
